description: This file contains the PHP class 'Item' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Shipping'. It defines a shipping method for items, including methods to get shipping quotes based on address and cart contents, with integration to localization, currency, tax, and session handling.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Class representing a shipping extension for item-based shipping, responsible for providing shipping quotes based on cart content and address.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Returns an array of shipping quote options based on the provided address, calculating costs and tax accordingly.
